CPU execution of the exported LittleCMS2.19 linear RGB/matrix/IEC-sRGB display stages. The source and both scalar/SIMD resources are pinned in `PINNED.json`; the LittleCMS reference and its license are in `../color-managed-native/`. No camera, profile-name or file-format list chooses the mathematics.

```sh
python3 scripts/build-lcms-display-cpu.py --emscripten-root /path/to/emsdk/upstream/emscripten
```

The Auto owner considers this runtime lazily after a retained, useful canonical CPU prefix and only for authentic native RGB16. Explicit CPU remains the canonical LittleCMS transform. Ordinary RGB8 input and promoted RGB8 do not load it. The GPU choice remains first.

The complete exported stages are validated before use. The native RGB16 samples are read-only; the SDR display projection has a measured/analytical encoded error at most1e-4 and at most one 8-bit output code. Scalar and SIMD share the same float32 operations and final quantization. Their versioned output provenance remains distinct from the GPU implementation. The imported memory maximum is32MiB, within the common admitted color workspace, and all native pointers/backings retire before its reservation is returned. Resource-ledger retirement is not a promise of immediate host RSS reclamation.
